paras: 12 Days Jaipur-Pushkar-Bikaner-Jaisalmer-Jodhpur-Mount Abu-Udaipur-Ranthambhore Tour Package
Tour Code #DR068
Rs.25999/- per person
Day 01 – Arrival in Jaipur
Welcome to Jaipur! known as Pink City, it fascinates with its royal palaces, famous forts, and colorful markets. Experience the royal glory and cultural prosperity of Rajasthan's capital.

Our representative will greet you at the Jaipur Railway Station or Airport. After arriving, check in at your hotel and relax for a bit. In the evening, we will visit some modern attractions of the Pink City:
Statue Circle - Symbol of Rajasthan's Proud Heritage
Birla Auditorium & Planetarium - Explore Stars and Scientific Wonders
Vidhan Sabha - Heart of Rajasthan's Democracy
Birla Mandir - Divine Peace Amidst Urban Rush
Jawahar Kala Kendra - Art and Culture in Harmony
Later, enjoy a delicious Rajasthani dinner at a resort with pleasant folk music and cultural dances in a village setting. Overnight stay at your hotel in Jaipur.
Day 02 – Jaipur Sightseeing
After breakfast, we will explore the old pink city and visit these places:
Hawa Mahal - Wind Palace of Pink City
City Palace - Royal Splendor in Every Corner
Observatory / Jantar Mantar - Ancient Wisdom Meets Astronomical Marvel
Jal Mahal - Palace Floats on Tranquil Waters
Amer Fort - Majestic Fortress of Rich History
Nahargarh Fort & Palace - Panoramic Views, Regal Architecture United
In the evening, enjoy a Light & Sound show at Amer Fort, showcasing the magnificent history of Rajasthan. Overnight stay at your hotel in Jaipur.
Day 03 – Jaipur – Ajmer/Pushkar
Ajmer: A spiritual hub, Ajmer is home to the revered Ajmer Sharif Dargah. Experience the city's rich religious heritage, bustling markets, and serene Ana Sagar Lake.
Pushkar is renowned for its sacred Pushkar Lake and the Brahma Temple, Pushkar is a vibrant pilgrimage site. Enjoy the lively Pushkar Camel Fair and the town's bohemian vibe.
After breakfast, we will head to Pushkar. Upon arrival, check in at your hotel. Then, we will visit Ajmer and Pushkar, famous pilgrimage centers:
Dargah of Khwaja Muin-ud-din Chisti at Ajmer - Spiritual Haven of Peaceful Reflection
Lord Brahma Temple at Pushkar - Sacred Hub of Divine Presence
Overnight stay at your hotel in Pushkar.
Day 04 – Jaipur - Bikaner
After breakfast, we will check out from the hotel and transfer to Bikaner, a city in the Thar Desert. Upon arrival, check in at your hotel. We will visit amazing places in Bikaner:
Junagarh Fort - Ancient Stronghold of Rajput Valor
Camel Breeding Farm - Nurturing the Ship of Desert
Karni Mata Temple - Holy Sanctuary of Revered Rats
Overnight stay at your hotel in Bikaner.
Day 05 – Bikaner - Jaisalmer
Jaisalmer: The "Golden City" Jaisalmer mesmerizes with its yellow sandstone architecture and the magnificent Jaisalmer Fort. Experience desert safaris, ornate havelis, and a glimpse into desert life.
After breakfast, we will drive to Jaisalmer and check in at your hotel. After freshening up, we will visit the Golden City:
War Museum - Echoes of Valor and Sacrifice
Gadisar Lake - Tranquil Oasis in Desert Sands
Vyas Chhatri - Architectural Serenity Amidst Desert Beauty
Overnight stay at your hotel in Jaisalmer.
Day 06 – Sightseeing & Jaisalmer Desert
After breakfast, we will explore Jaisalmer, the golden city of Rajasthan:
Jaisalmer Fort & Palaces - Golden Citadel of Desert Majesty
Jain Temples - Sacred Marvels of Intricate Carvings
Patwon Ki Haveli - Exquisite Architectural Heritage of Jaisalmer
Salim Singh Ki Haveli - Elegant Residence in Desert Splendor
Nathmal Ki Haveli - Symphony of Sandstone Artistry
Later, experience a night in the desert with cultural programs, a camel ride, bonfire, sunset, and dinner. Overnight stay at the Desert Camp.
Day 07 – Jaisalmer – Jodhpur Sightseeing
The "Blue City" Jodhpur boasts the majestic fort and a sea of blue houses. Discover its rich history, exciting shopping markets, and scenic views of the Thar Desert.
After breakfast, we will check out from the desert camp and move towards Jodhpur. After checking in at your hotel, we will visit the Blue City:
Umaid Bhawan Palace Museum - Grandeur Preserved in Royal Legacy
Jaswant Thada - Marble Serenity Amidst History
Mehrangarh Fort - Guardian of Jodhpur's Legacy
Clock Tower & Markets - Pulse of Jodhpur's Vibrant Culture
Overnight stay at your hotel in Jodhpur.
Day 08 – Udaipur – Mount Abu Sightseeing

Mount Abu is Rajasthan's only hill station, Mount Abu offers a refreshing retreat with cool climate, lush greenery, and scenic viewpoints. Visit the famous Dilwara Temples and enjoy the peaceful Nakki Lake.
After breakfast, we will head to Mount Abu. Check in at your hotel, and then visit the major attractions of Mount Abu:
Delwara Temple - Divine Elegance in Marble
Vedi Temple - Spiritual Haven Amidst Hills
Nakki Lake - Tranquil Mirror of Nature
Sunset Point - Nature's Canvas Unfolding Beauty
Toad Rock - Nature's Art
Guru Shikhar - Peak of Spiritual Solace
Achalgarh Mahadev - Ancient Spiritual Resonance
Brahma Kumari Ashram - Spiritual Retreat in Tranquility
Overnight stay at your hotel in Mount Abu.
Day 09 – Mount Abu - Ranakpur - Udaipur

After breakfast, we will proceed to Udaipur. On the way, we will visit Ranakpur Jain Temples, known for their splendid architectural style. Later, we will transfer to Udaipur and check in at your hotel. Overnight stay at your hotel in Udaipur.
Day 10 – Udaipur Sightseeing
Udaipur also known as the "City of Lakes," it enchants with its serene waters, grand palaces, and romantic atmosphere. Visit the exquisite City Palace and enjoy a boat ride on Lake Pichola.
After breakfast, we will explore every nook and corner of the Lake City, including:
City Palace - Palatial Marvel by Lake Pichola
Jagdish Temple - Architectural Gem of Udaipur
Bhartiya Lok Kala Mandal - Cultural Heritage in Living Art
Pratap Smarak - Heroic Tribute to Maharana Pratap
Shilp Gram - Artisan Village of Crafts
Bagore Ki Haveli - Timeless Heritage on Lake Shore
Saheliyon Ki Bari - Garden of Maidens' Delight
Overnight stay at your hotel in Udaipur.
Day 11 – Udaipur - Ranthambhore

After breakfast, we will drive to Ranthambhore and check in at your hotel. After some relaxation, we will visit the beautiful Ranthambhore National Park, famous for its wildlife. In the afternoon, enjoy a jungle safari by canter. Overnight stay at your hotel in Ranthambhore.
Day 12 – Ranthambhore - Jaipur Departure
After breakfast, we will depart for Jaipur. You will be dropped off at the Jaipur Railway Station or Airport for your onward journey. The tour ends here. Safe travels!
Package Inclusions:
* Daily breakfast
* Air-conditioned car for transportation throughout the journey
* Driver allowance, fuel, parking fees, and all applicable taxes
* Accommodation in 3-star hotels
* Government-approved tourist guide service for sightseeing in Jaipur
* 01 Jungle Safari at Ranthambhore National Park by Canter
* Camel Ride, Bonfire, Hi-Tea, Cultural Programs & Vegetarian Dinner at Desert Camp
* Complimentary accommodation for children below 5 years of age
Package Exclusions:
* Meals other than those specified in the inclusions
* Personal expenses such as tips, telephone calls, and laundry
* Entrance fees to monuments and attractions
* Camera fees
* Any tickets for trains, flights, or buses
* Travel insurance
Things to note

* Rates may vary during peak seasons such as New Year and Diwali.
12 Days Delhi-Agra-Jaipur-Ajmer/Pushkar-Udaipur-Mount Abu-Jodhpur-Jaisalmer Tour Package
Tour Code #DR069
Rs.25699/- per person
Day 01: Arrival in Delhi

Upon your arrival at Delhi Railway Station/Airport, our representative will warmly welcome you and escort you to your hotel. Rest and relax after your journey. Delhi, the capital city of India, is renowned for its rich culture, vibrant markets, and delectable cuisine.
Overnight stay at a hotel in Delhi.
Day 02: Delhi Sightseeing
After a hearty breakfast, embark on a tour to explore the highlights of Delhi:
Red Fort: Iconic symbol of Mughal grandeur.
Purana Quila: Ancient fort with a serene ambiance.
Jama Masjid: Magnificent mosque of Mughal era.
Qutub Minar: Tallest brick minaret in the world.
India Gate: War memorial with patriotic fervour.
Chandni Chowk: Lively market street for shopping.
Lakshmi Narayan Temple: Hindu temple complex with intricate carvings.
Overnight stay at a hotel in Delhi.
Day 03: Delhi - Agra
Agra is home to the wonderful Taj Mahal, Agra catches attention of visitors with its rich Mughal tradition. Explore grand forts, beautiful gardens, and everlasting architectural wonders.
After breakfast, proceed to Agra. Upon arrival, check in at the hotel and relax. Later, explore the beautiful city of Agra:
Taj Mahal: A timeless symbol of love.
Agra Fort: Historical fort with splendid architecture.
Itimad-Ud-Daulah (Baby Taj): Elegant marble mausoleum.
Markets & Bazaars: Shopping delights for souvenirs.
Overnight stay at a hotel in Agra.
Day 04: Agra - Jaipur

After breakfast, journey to Jaipur. Jaipur also known as Pink City, it fascinates with its royal palaces, famous forts, and colorful markets. Experience the royal glory and cultural prosperity of Rajasthan's capital.
Check in at the hotel and relax. In the evening, explore the modern attractions of Jaipur, known as the Pink City:
Statue Circle - Elegance etched in stone history.
Birla Auditorium & Planetarium - Celestial wonders unfold, stars shine.
Vidhan Sabha - Where laws shape our future.
Birla Mandir (Laxmi Narayan Temple) - Divine serenity in architectural grace.
Jawahar Kala Kendra - Art speaks, culture echoes, creativity.
Enjoy a delightful Rajasthani dinner at a resort, with folk music and cultural dances in a rural setting.
Overnight stay at a hotel in Jaipur.
Day 05: Jaipur Sightseeing
After breakfast, explore the historic Pink City:
Hawa Mahal: Palace of Winds with ornate façade.
City Palace: Residence of Jaipur's royal family.
Observatory (Jantar Mantar): Ancient astronomical observatory.
Jal Mahal: Water palace amidst Man Sagar Lake.
Amer Fort: Majestic hilltop fortress of Amer.
Nahargarh Fort: Scenic fort overlooking Jaipur.
In the evening, enjoy the mesmerizing Light & Sound show at Amer Fort.
Overnight stay at a hotel in Jaipur.
Day 06: Jaipur – Ajmer – Pushkar – Udaipur

After breakfast, proceed to Udaipur. Udaipur also known as the "City of Lakes," it enchants with its serene waters, grand palaces, and romantic atmosphere. Visit the exquisite City Palace and enjoy a boat ride on Lake Pichola.
On the route, we will visit the sacred sites of Ajmer and Pushkar:
Dargah of Khwaja Muin-ud-din Chishti in Ajmer
Lord Brahma Temple in Pushkar
Continue your journey to Udaipur and check in at the hotel. Relax and unwind.
Overnight stay at a hotel in Udaipur.
Day 07: Udaipur Sightseeing
After breakfast, explore the enchanting Lake City:
City Palace: Magnificent palace complex on Lake Pichola.
Pratap Smarak: Memorial place of Maharana Pratap.
Bhartiya Lok Kala Mandal: Museum showcasing Rajasthani folk arts.
Saheliyon ki Bari: Garden of maidens with fountains.
Jagdish Temple: Sacred Hindu temple with intricate architecture.
Bagore ki Haveli: Historical mansion with cultural performances.
Shilp Gram: Crafts village celebrating local artisans.
Fateh Sagar Lake: Picturesque lake offering serene views.
Overnight stay at a hotel in Udaipur.
Day 08: Udaipur – Mount Abu Sightseeing

After breakfast, proceed to Mount Abu. Mount Abu is Rajasthan's only hill station, Mount Abu offers a refreshing retreat with cool climate, lush greenery, and scenic viewpoints. Visit the famous Dilwara Temples and enjoy the peaceful Nakki Lake.
Check in at the hotel and relax. Explore the hill station of Rajasthan:
Delwara Temple: Exquisite Jain temple architecture.
Vedi Temple: Ancient Hindu temple dedicated to Ved.
Nakki Lake:Scenic Lake with boating options.
Sunset Point: Viewpoint for breathtaking sunsets.
Tod Rock: Natural rock formation with panoramic views.
Guru Shikhar: Highest peak in the Aravalli Range.
Achalgarh Mahadev Temple: Ancient temple dedicated to Lord Shiva.
Brahma Kumari Ashram: Spiritual retreat for meditation.
Overnight stay at a hotel in Mount Abu.
Day 09: Mount Abu - Ranakpur - Jodhpur

After breakfast, proceed to Jodhpur. The "Blue City" Jodhpur boasts the majestic fort and a sea of blue houses. Discover its rich history, exciting shopping markets, and scenic views of the Thar Desert.
On the route, visit the exquisite Ranakpur Jain Temples known for their intricate architecture and serene surroundings. Later, continue to Jodhpur and check in at the hotel.
Overnight stay at a hotel in Jodhpur.
Day 10: Jodhpur Sightseeing
After breakfast, explore the vibrant Blue City of Jodhpur:
Ummaid Bhawan Palace Museum: Opulent palace turned museum.
Jaswant Thada: White marble memorial with intricate carvings.
Mehrangarh Fort: Majestic fort offering panoramic views.
Mandore Garden:Historic Garden with monuments and temples.
Clock Tower & Markets: Bustling markets for shopping and local culture.
Overnight stay at a hotel in Jodhpur.
Day 11: Jodhpur - Jaisalmer Desert
Jaisalmer: The "Golden City" Jaisalmer mesmerizes with its yellow sandstone architecture and the magnificent Jaisalmer Fort. Experience desert safaris, ornate havelis, and a glimpse into desert life.
After breakfast, proceed to Jaisalmer. Check in at the hotel and relax. Explore the Golden City of Rajasthan:
Jaisalmer Fort & Palaces: Ancient fort complex with royal residences.
Jain Temples: Intricately carved temples dedicated to Jain Tirthankaras.
Patwon ki Haveli: Historic mansion showcasing intricate architecture.
Salim Singh ki Haveli: Elegant haveli with distinct architecture.
Nathmal ki Haveli: Twin haveli reflecting fine craftsmanship.
Later, experience a unique overnight stay in tent accommodation at a desert camp. Enjoy cultural programs, camel rides, a bonfire, sunset views, and dinner under the starlit desert sky.
Day 12: Jaisalmer Departure
After breakfast, return to Jaisalmer for your departure. Our driver will drop you off at Jaisalmer Railway Station or Airport as per your travel plans. Your memorable Rajasthan tour concludes here.

This itinerary offers a comprehensive journey through the cultural and historical gems of Delhi, Agra, Jaipur, Udaipur, Mount Abu, Jodhpur, and Jaisalmer, ensuring a delightful experience of Rajasthan's rich heritage and natural beauty.
